source_ref: GSS codebook variable pages via gssrdoc: https://kjhealy.github.io/gssrdoc/reference/{abdefect,abnomore,abhlth,abpoor,abrape,absingle,abany}.html (each cites General Social Survey, https://gss.norc.org); code derivation read from data/Rdatasets.R; Rdatasets entry https://vincentarelbundock.github.io/Rdatasets/ (stevedata::gss_abortion)
note: mapping_basis=data_labels by derivation, not by assertion: data/Rdatasets.R does `x<-x[,c("abany","abdefect","abnomore","abhlth","abpoor","abrape","absingle")]` then `item=names(x)[i]`, so the IRW item code IS the source column name -- core model section 3 pattern 1, nothing positional and no rename. Each of those names is a GSS variable mnemonic whose own codebook page prints the verbatim question, so code and text are tied at the source. text_source=canonical_instrument rather than study_materials because the words come from the GSS codebook, not from the Rdatasets port: the port's own documentation (reproduced in the header of data/Rdatasets.R) only paraphrases each variable ('a numeric vector that equals 1 if the respondent thinks abortion should be legal if...'), which pins the mapping but is not what respondents heard. Three transcription deviations are listed in notes_rdatasets_gssabortion.csv. Rights: no quotable restriction found; see the same note.
